_about: Starter vocabulary for a consulting or transformation engagement. A FIRST DRAFT to edit. Property value is [Domain, Range, inverse_or_null, description]. Use A|B for a union.
_summary: Engagements: scope, deliverables, governance, sessions, decisions and the work that follows.
name: Engagement Knowledge Base

classes.Engagement: A contracted body of work between a supplier and a client, with a scope and a period.
classes.Organization: A company or a unit within one: the client, the supplier, a division, a function.
classes.Person: A named individual. Consider carefully whether you need this class at all; see the README.
classes.Role: A defined function in the target operating model or the delivery team. Filled by a person.
classes.Workstream: One scope area of the engagement, with its own plan and owner.
classes.Deliverable: A contracted artifact with a due date and an acceptance condition.
classes.GovernanceForum: A recurring body that decides or validates: a steering committee, a working group, a review board.
classes.Session: A dated event that produced something: an interview, a workshop, a meeting. Distinct from the transcript recording it.
classes.Decision: A choice made, proposed or deferred, with its reason. Superseded by a later decision, never overwritten.
classes.ActionItem: A committed task arising from a session or a decision, with an owner and a state.
classes.Question: An open question raised and not yet answered, with an owner.
classes.Concept: A construct the engagement designs or adopts: an operating model element, a way of working, a capability.
classes.Framework: A reusable method or model brought to the engagement rather than invented in it.
classes.Document: A source document in the corpus: a contract, a deck, a transcript, a plan.

client_of: The client an engagement is for.
scoped_as: A workstream inside an engagement's scope.
produces: What a workstream or session produced.
member_of: Membership in an organization or forum.
instance_of: A session that is one meeting of a recurring forum.
recorded_in: The document that records a session.
raised: An outcome that came out of a session.
discusses: A subject a session or document covers.
implements: An action item carrying out a decision.
informed_by: A method or model relied on.
supersedes: This replaced that. Use with the temporal fields, never by overwriting.
